inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 AR cash flow statement: equity-settled transactions GBP24.3m (ITRK.L_Annual_FY2025.txt:11337) plus tax paid on share awards vested GBP10.1m (line 11309); the GBP1.8m 'tax paid on share buyback' (stamp duty, line 11308) is excluded because it is a buyback cost, not compensation
inputs.fx_note: Statements and flows in GBP (millions); LSE quote in pence (GBp = 1/100 GBP). fx_rate 100 converts model GBP per share to quote pence. No dual listing to parity-check; the conversion is definitional, not a market rate.
inputs.price_as_of: 2026-10-09T16:15:00Z regular close (Yahoo chart API); not an after-hours print
inputs.share_count_basis: Diluted weighted average 154.8m, H1 FY2026 note 5 (ITRK.L_HalfYear_H1-2026.txt:1623); the GBP350m buyback completed in 2025 so the period-end count matches the half-year average. Held FLAT because SBC is fully expensed in the flows (charging both would double-count).
inputs.wacc_rationale: GBP-built: 10y gilt ~4.5% + 5.0% ERP x beta ~0.9 = ~9.0% cost of equity; pre-tax cost of debt 3.9% (company's weighted average rate, H1 FY2026) = ~2.9% after 26% tax; ~16% debt weight at standalone equity value -> WACC 8.0%. Same WACC in every scenario: risk is charged once, in the scenario flows and weights, never also in the rate.
inputs.lease_treatment: (B) leases as operating cost: full lease cash (FY2025 principal GBP78.4m + IFRS 16 interest GBP11.5m = GBP89.9m, 2.6% of revenue) charged inside EBIT via lease_cost_pct_path; lease liabilities (GBP319.3m at 2026-06-30) EXCLUDED from net_debt; D&A for cash tax is ex right-of-use depreciation and ex acquisition-intangible amortisation (FY2025 depreciation + software amortisation GBP167.0m less ~GBP78m ROU depreciation = ~GBP89m, 2.6%).
inputs.nci_treatment: Flows are consolidated (100%); non-controlling interests charged ONCE in the equity bridge: FY2026 guided NCI profit share GBP20-21m (H1 FY2026 outlook) capitalised at ~15x = GBP300m deducted. NCI equity on the balance sheet is GBP44.6m (FY2025 note 20); dividends to NCI GBP16.1m/yr.
inputs.notes: THIS DRIVERS FILE IS THE STANDALONE (DEAL-BREAKS) MODEL ONLY. Intertek is subject to a shareholder-approved (98.72%, 6 Aug 2026) take-private by EQT/Isotope Bidco under a UK scheme of arrangement; SKILL.md routes a live scheme to deal-completes vs deal-breaks weighting. The engine output from this file is the deal-breaks leg; the shipped ITRK.L_DCF.json replaces the bull slot with the deal-completes scenario (PV of the GBP60.00 remaining cash consideration) and re-weights. Model for this leg: owner-FCF component DCF, 10-year horizon, GBP. EBITDA margin is PRE-SBC (statutory EBITDA GBP745.2m + GBP24.3m SBC = GBP769.5m, 22.4%) because IFRS statutory EBITDA already expenses SBC; the engine then deducts sbc_pct once. EBITDA is statutory (after ~GBP25m/yr of cash SDIs for restructuring/M&A), i.e. deal costs and integration costs are treated as recurring for a serial bolt-on acquirer. Interest income (GBP3.7m) not stripped: the company is net debt, so there is no cash pile being double-counted. reported_fcf GBP327.0m is the company's levered definition (after GBP66.1m interest paid and GBP78.4m lease principal); last_fcf = 327.0 - 34.4 = 292.6 (levered owner FCF). The component build is UNLEVERED (interest lives in WACC), so year-1 component FCF runs ~GBP45-50m above last_fcf plus ~GBP50m of 2025 working-capital outflow that is not repeated; working capital is structurally negative (-GBP45.7m at FY2025), so wc_capture is 0. Timing: fy0 = FY2025 with Y1 = FY2026 discounted a full year, against a 2026-06-30 balance sheet -> H1 FY2026 FCF (GBP101m) is effectively counted in both, which is conservative by ~GBP0.6/share; it also correctly excludes the 107.7p FY2025 final dividend already paid. Buyback: GBP367.9m in FY2025 (GBP350m programme + employee-trust purchases) funded the flat count; no buyback since the offer. Pension: UK scheme surplus GBP31.2m, Swiss deficit GBP2.5m, net immaterial, ignored.

equity_bridge.item: Non-controlling interests (FY26 guided NCI profit GBP20-21m x ~15x)
equity_bridge.note: H1 FY2026 outlook; FY2025 AR note 20 NCI equity GBP44.6m, NCI dividends GBP16.1m

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: revenue_5yr_cagr (4.6%) cross-checked against FY2026 guidance of mid-single-digit LFL growth and H1 FY2026 actual +5.9% reported / +6.1% constant currency
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity CAGR (-5.5% 3yr, +2.1% 5yr) diverges >30% from revenue/EPS because the GBP350m FY2025 buyback and GBP252m dividends shrank book equity; book value is not the growth anchor for a 21% ROIC asset-light business. Owner-FCF CAGR is negative (-5.6% 5yr) against +4.6% revenue: FY2020 was inflated by COVID working-capital inflows and FY2025 depressed by a GBP50m WC outflow and GBP14m higher interest; SBC is NOT the cause (SBC fell from 0.65% to 0.71% of revenue, flat).
historical_growth.notes: FCF CAGRs use the owner-FCF series (reported FCF - SBC - tax on vested awards) across the whole history: FY2020 389.5, FY2022 346.5, FY2025 292.6.

base.narrative: Standalone Intertek if the scheme lapses: FY2026 at guidance (mid-single-digit LFL plus bolt-ons; H1 +5.9% reported), decelerating to 2.5% by year 10; pre-SBC EBITDA margin from 22.4% to 24.5% (adjusted operating margin ~18.1% -> ~19.4%, past the 18.5%+ medium-term target but slower than the 240bps delivered 2023-25); capex 4.2%, cash tax 26% (guided ETR 25.5-26.5%), SBC 1.0% flat.

bull.narrative: Standalone bull (reference only; replaced by the deal-completes scenario in the shipped DCF): Consumer Products and Corporate Assurance compound at the top of guidance, World of Energy recovers, bolt-ons add ~1pp a year; margin reaches 26% pre-SBC (adjusted operating margin ~21%).

bear.narrative: Standalone bear: the scheme lapses on a regulatory block and the business meets a trade/tariff-driven slowdown in consumer-goods sourcing and a weak World of Energy; FY2027 growth 2%, margin gives back the FY2026 gain and stalls at 23% pre-SBC; terminal growth 2%, cap 16x.

scenario_narratives.base: Deal breaks, standalone base: mid-single-digit LFL growth plus bolt-ons, margin progression toward and past the 18.5%+ adjusted operating margin target, 26% cash tax, leases expensed, NCI deducted.
scenario_narratives.bull: Standalone bull, reference leg only (superseded in the shipped DCF by the deal-completes scenario).
scenario_narratives.bear: Deal breaks on a regulatory block into a consumer-sourcing/energy downturn; growth 2-3%, margin stalls at 23% pre-SBC.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Engine-default weights for the STANDALONE reference model only; the shipped DCF JSON re-weights deal-completes vs deal-breaks (see its probability_weighted block).

valuation_philosophy.summary: Standalone owner-FCF DCF leg of a deal-weighted valuation. See ITRK.L_DCF.json valuation_philosophy for the full approach.
key_risks_to_valuation: Rising leverage (1.4x net debt/EBITDA after the FY2025 buyback)
